mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuation and increase the attractiveness of equities relative to fixed income.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) with a 3-month annualized inflation rate exceeding 2.0% signals an inflationary cycle that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL 3-month change exceeds 2.0%, or the rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 850,000 units, it signals a strong labor market and robust housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% AND HOUST > 850.0, or the rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by strong GDP growth (GDPC1 6-month growth > 2.0%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL 12-month growth > 2.5%), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to heightened risk of central bank tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 6-month growth > 2.0% AND CPIAUCSL 12-month growth > 2.5%, or the rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (2017=100) signals a weakening economy and increased risk of recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals a deteriorating labor market and increased economic uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 800,000 units signals weak consumer demand and a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 800.0, or the rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 400,000 million dollars signals weak consumer spending and a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS < 400000.0, or the rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
